answer.rationale: p99 latency at 5x target during peak settlement window with security patch that cannot be rolled back. Rollback is eliminated by compliance constraint. Add_capacity is too slow for immediate relief. Regional failover (memory_b2) demonstrated fast latency recovery with clean traffic shift during March degradation. Route read replicas (memory_b5) only addresses read load, not write path pressure. Circuit breaker (memory_b4) would shed traffic rather than preserve writes. Regional failover can redistribute write load across healthy regions, recover latency fast, and preserve all transactional capacity during peak settlement. We verify memory_b2 (confirmed failover restores latency) and memory_b5 (to confirm read replica routing is not the appropriate lever here for write-path saturation). This is a standard experiment scale—shift one region cohort, monitor error/latency delta, preserve option to expand if effective.
